module TopModule (
  input [15:0] scancode,
  output reg left,
  output reg down,
  output reg right,
  output reg up
);

  localparam KEY_LEFT  = 8'h45; // Example key code for Left
  localparam KEY_DOWN  = 8'h46; // Example key code for Down
  localparam KEY_RIGHT = 8'h47; // Example key code for Right
  localparam KEY_UP    = 8'h48; // Example key code for Up

  always @(*) begin
    // Initialize all outputs to 0
    left  = 1'b0;
    down  = 1'b0;
    right = 1'b0;
    up    = 1'b0;

    case (scancode)
      16'h0001: left  = 1'b1; // Key Left pressed
      16'h0002: down  = 1'b1; // Key Down pressed
      16'h0004: right = 1'b1; // Key Right pressed
      16'h0008: up    = 1'b1; // Key Up pressed
      // Additional keys can be added here if needed
      default: ; // No action, outputs remain 0
    endcase
  end

endmodule

  input reset,
  output reg [3:0] q
);

always @(posedge clk) begin

    q <= 4'd0;

    if (q == 4'd9) begin
      q <= 4'd0;
    end else begin
      q <= q + 4'd1;
    end
  end
end

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input a,
  input b,
  input c,
  input d,
  output out_sop,
  output out_pos
);

  wire and1_out, and2_out, and3_out;

  assign and1_out = a & b & c;         // AND of a, b, c
  assign and2_out = b & ~d & c;        // AND of b, NOT d, c
  assign and3_out = ~a & d & ~b & c;   // AND of NOT a, d, NOT b, c

  assign out_sop = and1_out;           // Output out_sop from and1_out
  assign out_pos = and2_out | and3_out; // OR of and2_out and and3_out

endmodule

module TopModule (
  input  [3:0] in,
  output [3:0] out_both,
  output [3:0] out_any,
  output [3:0] out_different
);

  assign out_both = in & in;  // Bitwise AND of each bit with itself (result: 0 except LSB)
  assign out_any = in | in;  // Bitwise OR of each bit with itself (result: all 1s)
  assign out_different = in ^ in; // Bitwise XOR of each bit with itself (result: 0 except LSB)

endmodule
